from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityDegreeData(BaseModel):
    """Degree statistics for a single university from a CDS report."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the university")
    total_bachelors_awarded: int | None = Field(description="Total number of Bachelor's degrees awarded")
    social_sciences_percentage: float | None = Field(description="Percentage of Bachelor's degrees in Social Sciences")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this data (e.g., '2020-2021')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_degree_data: list[UniversityDegreeData]
